properties.description: At every eligible pre/post sample, occupancy equals the independent queue count. Writes at full and reads at empty are rejected using pre-edge expected occupancy, including simultaneous requests.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independently expected queue contains 16 words.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independently expected queue contains zero words.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, front data equals its oldest accepted word. Checks ordering, retention, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, and continued operation after reset; empty data is unconstrained.
At every eligible sample, observed occupancy is known and in the legal range zero through 16.
Following each synchronous reset edge until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is deasserted, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation.
